audience: Egyptian business owners and marketers scrolling Facebook/Instagram Reels who need ads, motion graphics or product films
promise: PIXEL Plus turns your idea into a short film people actually watch and remember — script, motion, sound and delivery handled for you
cta: ابدأ مشروعك — ابعتلنا رسالة (send PIXEL Plus a message; no phone/URL invented)
direction: Reference-matched (owner-supplied SaaS promo): white / ink / electric-blue graphic film, a ray-marched 3-D mascot dithered into square screen pixels, bold Alexandria headlines with ONE blue Aref Ruqaa accent word per scene, HUD labels + timecode, dot / push / whip / pixel-iris transitions, 120 BPM groove, natural Egyptian voiceover.

assets.rights: Original PIXEL Plus mascot modelled in code for this film (2026-10-02); not derived from the reference character's mesh, texture or likeness beyond the general idea of a friendly dithered 3-D mascot
Alexandria, Aref Ruqaa, Space Mono, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Instrument Serif — SIL OFL 1.1 (see ASSETS.md)

sound.note: Music and SFX synthesised in film6/score.mjs (lib/audio.mjs + lib/sfx.mjs). Voiceover: optional film6/voice/*.mp3 rendered by tools/tts_edge.py (Microsoft Edge neural ar-EG voice) when that host is reachable; otherwise the film is built without VO and says so.

creative.viewer: a small-business owner in Egypt who has a product or idea and no in-house video team
creative.problem: ads look generic or nobody watches them; making a film feels slow and complicated
creative.promise: one agency does the whole film — idea to delivery — and it is made to be seen
creative.evidence: the film itself: a 20 s Reels ad made end-to-end by the studio (character, motion, type, music, formats); the board scene lists only steps the studio really performs
creative.emotion: confident, friendly, quick — a smile, not a lecture
creative.motif: the square screen pixel: the mascot, the transitions and the logo resolve on one dithered pixel grid
creative.light: one key light from the upper left on the mascot and objects, ordered 8×8 dither to two inks; flat graphic fields elsewhere

typography.text: Aref Ruqaa Bold in blue for one accent word per scene; Space Mono + IBM Plex Sans Arabic for HUD labels

creative.camera: flat graphic stage; gentle push-ins, one lateral push between scenes, a spring slam on the stamp
creative.motion: spring pops with overshoot, per-word rise with blur, cards with tilt-settle, typed script, beat-locked whip words
creative.sound: 120 BPM house groove in A Phrygian, claps and shakers, warm bass; pops, whooshes, UI confirms on the checks, one stamp impact, bloom shimmer; music ducks under the voice
creative.pacing: hook 3 s · services 3 s · result 3 s · whip 1 s · board 3 s · dark line 3 s · end card 4 s (held 1.2 s)
creative.payoff: PIXEL Plus wordmark resolves out of pixels with the mascot behind it and «خلّي فكرتك تتشاف»
